blocks.prompt: Discuss the nature of optimization problems and give real-world examples (long question 4).
blocks.explanation: An optimization problem has many valid solutions and asks for the best one by a measure such as least cost, shortest distance or greatest value, usually under constraints. Examples: planning the shortest delivery route (Travelling Salesman Problem), packing the most valuable load within a weight limit (knapsack problem), and paying an amount with the fewest coins (coin change). Many such problems are hard, so greedy methods or dynamic programming are used.

items: Problem classes: decision (yes/no), search (find), optimization (best), counting (how many).
